remarks: Updated and fully painted Inside and Out. Historic Antique Colonial in South Wilton - 4 Beds | 2.5 Baths | 2,803 Sq Ft + Walk-Out Lower Level | 4.81 Acres. Known as the historic "James Benedict" house, this central chimney (5 fireplaces : 3 gas and 2 wood) 3-story, post and beam construction residence is one of the notable and better-preserved 18th century dwellings in town. All light fixtures have been updated with LED, Three bathrooms updated. Wide plank floors refinished , Dusk to down exterior lighting, Hot water baseboard gas heat and Mini split systems that provide high quality, low noise comfort AC and can also supply heat as an alternative energy source. Step into Wilton's past and reimagine its future within the walls of this charming home, offering 2,803 sq ft of cozy living space The possibilities for relaxation and entertainment are endless. Perfectly situated on a scenic lot in one of South Wilton's most desirable neighborhoods. This home blends timeless craftsmanship and is something truly special. From wide-plank hardwood floors and exposed beams to multiple gas/wood fireplaces, every historic corner tells a story. The unfinished lower level offers walk-out access, perfect for extra storage. Highlights: 4 bedrooms | 2 full baths | 1 half bath. Two staircases to upper level. Large eat in kitchen Minutes to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, Wilton Center, schools, and train station. Wilton has One of the best school systems in the country.
